summary: XCF Global filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 1 to its April 13, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with DevvStream Corp. and Southern Energy Renewables Inc. Simultaneous mergers will occur via XCF Global's wholly-owned subsidiaries, Southern Merger Sub and DevvStream Merger Sub, with EEME and GL as additional parties. The amendment adjusts pro forma ownership percentages by revising Southern Consideration Shares and DevvStream Consideration Shares definitions. XCF Global, formerly Focus Impact BH3 NewCo, trades as SAFX on Nasdaq. Watch for updated merger consideration mechanics, shareholder approvals and potential redemption dynamics in this de-SPAC business combination.
